title: Missiles Hit Riyadh Airport, American Goes All-In on Starlink, and Europe's Transatlantic Land Grab Continues
summary: A Houthi ballistic missile actually hits a parked Saudia jet at Riyadh's main airport, and we get into why that's a scary new chapter in this conflict. Plus, American Airlines doubles down on Starlink for its entire fleet, ten airlines pile into the transatlantic market with 29 new routes, and we revisit the first-class fee fight between American, Delta, and United.
